title: Final Speed Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final speed v must be correctly calculated using the given parameters.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The total energy E of the photons emitted must be correctly expressed as E = Nt.

title: Momentum Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between energy and momentum must be correctly applied, showing mv = E/c.

title: Variable Definitions
description: Important Criteria: All variables (N, m, t, c) must be clearly defined and used appropriately.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign errors in the momentum or speed calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Check for any missing factors in the final speed formula.
